pairing.title: Pairing with the enrolment module
pairing.lead: This environment pairs with a single enrolment module, which is the sole authority over its device assignment.
pairing.unreachable: The enrolment module is not answering right now. The request is neither rejected nor lost: it is still pending, and this screen will refresh on its own.

outcome.refusee: An administrator of the enrolment module rejected the request. A new one can be sent.
outcome.expiree: The request expired without an answer. A new one can be sent.

form.title: Request pairing
form.baseUrlHelp: An http(s) address without a path, for example https://enrolment.example.org
form.name: Name of this environment
form.nameHelp: It helps an administrator on the other side recognise the request they accept. It identifies nothing: the URL is what counts.

pending.title: Paste the pairing code
pending.where: The code is shown on the « Pairing » screen of {{url}}, next to the request carrying this environment's URL. It renews every thirty seconds.
pending.codeHelp: Spaces and line breaks are stripped automatically.

repair.title: Replace the current pairing?
repair.body: The current pairing will be replaced. Devices the previous enrolment module assigned to this environment will no longer be assigned by it.

errors.baseUrl: This URL is not in the expected shape: http(s), a host, optionally a port, and no path.
errors.name: This name is empty, too long, or contains forbidden characters.
errors.unreachable: This URL does not answer. Check that it is reachable from this server before trying again.
errors.refused: The code was refused: it is wrong, already used, or the request no longer exists. The request is still pending, another code can be entered.
errors.clockSkew: The code was right, but the two servers' clocks differ by about {{seconds}} seconds. Set the machines to the right time, then try again.
